title: “Is modern Christianity becoming too comfortable?”
paragraphs: Many churches today look more like stages than sanctuaries.

The lights are brighter.
The music is louder.
The messages feel good.
Where did the call to repentance go?

Jesus didn’t promise comfort.
He warned about narrow roads, persecution, and denying ourselves.
Yet in many places, sermons sound more like motivational speeches than a call to transformation.
When truth risks offending people, some leaders stay silent.

“Preach the word; be ready in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage.”
— 2 Timothy 4:2
The real gospel doesn’t just inspire people.

It confronts the heart.
It exposes sin.
And it calls us to change.
But conviction is what changes lives.
Be honest — do you see this happening?
👇 I want to hear your perspective.
